## ✨ Highlights

### Mailpit and other environment tools in one click

Every web tool an environment exposes (Mailpit, Adminer, Solr and the like) opens from the run header at its own preview address, behind the dashboard login. Terminal, IDE and these tools are now icon buttons next to the menu instead of being hidden inside it.

### Resize the preview, log and follow-up chat

The preview, the run log and the follow-up chat each have a handle at the bottom, so you can make them as tall as you need. The chat now starts at the same 16:9 size as the preview.

### Sessions with a 14-day overview

The runs overview is now called Sessions and lives at /sessions. Four small charts show the last 14 days: runs per day, success rate and median duration compared with the two weeks before, and how many runs a trigger started. Old run links from pull requests still open.

### Search lives in the sidebar

Search sits under the logo on every page and still opens with Cmd+K. It finds projects, workflows and settings.

## 🚀 New

- Projects and workflows can be shown as cards or as a list.
- The project and workflow filters are remembered between visits.
- Project settings are split into Environment, Agent, Integrations and Advanced pages.
- Project automation only lists the workflows that project triggers.
- The projects and workflows overviews drop their KPI cards (Less bloat).
- Release notes come with highlights and sections in the dashboard and on Discord.

## 🐛 Fixed

- A pull request step reuses the open PR for its branch instead of failing.
- A run's IDE is only reachable through the dashboard login.
- Runs can no longer reach each other's environments over the network.
- A preview can no longer act on the dashboard with the viewer's login.
- Preview certificates are only requested for addresses that exist.
